units.source_text: 今上一向知道髭黑太政大臣生前竭诚盼望大女公子入宫，

en.t: The present emperor had long known that the late Chancellor Higekuro had earnestly wished for his eldest daughter to enter the palace,

units.source_text: 如今看见玉鬘把她送入了冷泉院，不胜惊讶，

en.t: so when he now saw that Tamakazura had sent her to Reizei-in instead, he was deeply astonished,

units.source_text: 便宣召女公子的长兄左近中将入内，向他探询原由。

en.t: and he summoned the young lady's eldest brother, the Sakon Middle Captain, to court and asked him the reason.

units.source_text: 左近中将回家对母亲说道：“皇上生气了呢。

en.t: The Sakon Middle Captain returned home and said to his mother, "His Majesty is angry.

units.source_text: 我早就说过：这办法是世人所不赞善的。

en.t: I told you long ago that people would not approve of this plan.

units.source_text: 岂知母亲见解特异，决定如此措施，我就不便阻挠。

en.t: But since you had your own unusual view and decided on this course, I could hardly stand in your way.

units.source_text: 如今皇上见怪，我等为自身计，亦颇不利呢。”

en.t: Now that His Majesty takes offense, it is quite disadvantageous for us as well."

units.source_text: 他很不高兴，深怪母亲行事失当。

en.t: He was very displeased and strongly blamed his mother for having acted improperly.

units.source_text: 尚侍答道：“有什么办法呢？

en.t: The Naishi no Kami replied, "What could I have done?

units.source_text: 我本来不想如此匆匆决定。

en.t: I did not originally mean to decide so hastily.

units.source_text: 无奈冷泉院再三强求，说的话真可怜呢！

en.t: But Reizei-in pressed me again and again, and the things he said were truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 我想：没有可靠的后援人，入宫定多痛苦，

en.t: I thought that without a dependable patron, life in the palace would surely be very painful,

units.source_text: 倒不如在冷泉院来得安乐，因此我就答应了他。

en.t: and that she would be more at ease with Reizei-in, so I agreed to his request.

units.source_text: 既然谁都认为不妥，当时何不直言劝阻，而到现在来怪怨我呢？

en.t: If everyone thought it was improper, why did you not speak plainly and stop me then, instead of blaming me now?

units.source_text: 连夕雾右大臣也说我行事乖谬，我真痛苦啊！

en.t: Even Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, says that I acted perversely, and it pains me so much.

units.source_text: 这大概是前世因缘了。”

en.t: This must surely be karma from a former life."

units.source_text: 她从容地谈论，并不为此担心。

en.t: She spoke calmly and showed no worry over the matter.

units.source_text: 左近中将说：“前世因缘是眼睛所看不见的。

en.t: The Sakon Middle Captain said, "Karma from a former life is something no one can see.

units.source_text: 皇上向我们要人，我们难道可以回答他说‘此人与陛下没有前世因缘’么？

en.t: When His Majesty asks us for someone, can we really answer, 'This person has no bond from a former life with Your Majesty'?

units.source_text: 母亲说入宫怕明石皇后嫉妒，试问院内的弘徽殿女御如何？

en.t: You say that entering the palace would bring fear of Empress Akashi's jealousy, but what about Kokiden no Miyasudokoro at the retired emperor's residence?

units.source_text: 母亲预期女御会照顾她，会怎么样，我看不见得吧。

en.t: You expect that lady to look after her, but as for how things will turn out, I do not think it is so certain.

units.source_text: 好，且看将来事实吧。

en.t: Well then, let us see what happens in the future.

units.source_text: 仔细想来，宫中虽有明石皇后，不是还有其他妃嫔么？

en.t: If you think carefully, even though Empress Akashi is in the palace, are there not other consorts there as well?

units.source_text: 侍奉主上，只要和同辈相处得好就行，自古以来都认为这是幸福的。

en.t: In serving His Majesty, it is enough to get along well with one's peers, and from ancient times that has been considered good fortune.

units.source_text: 如今对这弘徽殿女御，如果稍有触犯，引起她的恶感，

en.t: Now, if she were to offend this Kokiden lady even slightly and arouse her dislike,

units.source_text: 世间便会谣诼纷传，视为乖事呢。”

en.t: rumors would immediately spread through the world, and people would regard it as a serious impropriety."

units.source_text: 他和兄弟两人纷纷议论，玉鬘尚侍不胜其苦。

en.t: He and his brother argued about it at length, and Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, could hardly bear the distress.
